description: Diagnosing learners' spontaneous speech, choosing a short list of features across suprasegmentals, segmentals and fluency, teaching each explicitly and then in communicative use is expected to improve listeners' understanding of learners' spontaneous speech; no claim tests the balanced curriculum, and the nearest evidence shows explicit instruction reliably improves controlled production of targeted features, with smaller, less certain gains in spontaneous speech.
title: Balanced pronunciation curriculum covering suprasegmentals, segmentals, and fluency, with a short list of central features selected by diagnosis
